recipients.note: Who receives each part of the bill. FCA pays for the fuel burned in Genera-operated plants (passed through to fuel suppliers). PPCA pays private generators. The base rate funds LUMA, Genera PR and PREPA (operations and pensions); the split is APPROXIMATE, in proportion to the budgets each entity requested in case NEPR-AP-2023-0003 (LUMA ≈ $1,900M, Genera ≈ $460M, PREPA ≈ $120M, pensions ≈ $307M). The Energy Bureau kept the total near $1,700M a year; its per-entity split is in the approved tariff book. Riders (CELI, subsidies, energy efficiency) go to municipalities and government programs. Edit base_split when the approved split is checked.
